lines.text: Moses asks his father-in-law Jethro to let him return to Egypt, and Jethro says, "Go in peace."
Moses puts his wife and sons on a donkey and heads for Egypt with the staff of God.
The LORD says He will harden Pharaoh's heart, and Moses must warn that God will kill Pharaoh's firstborn son.
At a lodging place the LORD is about to kill Moses, but his brother Aaron circumcises his son and the LORD lets him alone.

wrong_details.wrong: his brother Aaron circumcises his son
wrong_details.true: Zipporah takes a flint knife and circumcises her son

lines.text: Aaron meets Moses at Jethro's home in Midian, and after Moses performs the signs before the elders, the people believe and worship.
